subject: fixing tag query parsing (#602)
reason: The only behavioral change is in src/coordinator/search_converter.cc: gRPC fanout requests now re-parse tag query strings with the query-language '|' separator (FilterParser::ParseQueryTags) instead of the index's schema separator. That code runs only when the coordinator is active, which requires the hidden `use-coordinator` config — settable solely via the `--use-coordinator` module startup argument after the module path on the loadmodule directive (it is built Hidden, so CONFIG SET and config-file lines are rejected, and no FT._DEBUG controlled variable enables it). The fuzzer loads modules
